tools.name: list_deals
tools.title: List active deals
tools.description: List currently active JET-Around deals in Charlotte, NC, optionally filtered by a text search over the title, description, or venue name.

search.description: Optional text to match against deal title, description, or venue name.

limit.description: Maximum number of deals to return (default 20).

tools.name: list_favorites
tools.title: List my saved venues
tools.description: List the venues and deals the signed-in user has saved to their JET-Around favorites.

limit.description: Maximum number of favorites to return (default 50).

tools.name: save_favorite
tools.title: Save a venue to favorites
tools.description: Save a venue (and optionally a specific deal) to the signed-in user's JET-Around favorites.

venue_id.description: Identifier of the venue to save.

venue_category.description: Category such as food, drink, nightlife, or events.

deal_id.description: Optional deal id to associate with this favorite.

tools.name: remove_favorite
tools.title: Remove a saved venue
tools.description: Remove a saved venue from the signed-in user's JET-Around favorites by favorite id or venue id.

favorite_id.description: Id of the favorite row to remove.

venue_id.description: Venue id to remove from favorites when the favorite id is unknown.

tools.name: get_heatmap_density
tools.title: Get heatmap density snapshot
tools.description: Return the latest aggregated, anonymized crowd-density snapshot (grid cells with activity counts) for a time range, optionally limited to a radius around a location in Charlotte, NC.

time_window_minutes.description: How far back to look, in minutes (1 to 10080). Default 60.

radius_km.description: Radius in kilometers around the center point (default 5, requires latitude/longitude).

limit.description: Maximum number of density cells to return, busiest first (default 50).

tools.name: get_jetcard
tools.title: Get my JetCard
tools.description: Return the signed-in user's JetCard summary: membership status and tier, the associated merchant/venue, and the most recent account activity.

tools.name: configure_notifications
tools.title: Configure notifications
tools.description: Read or change the signed-in user's notification settings. Call with no arguments to read current settings; pass any of push_enabled, email_enabled, background_location_alerts, location_tracking, or auto_reload_updates to enable/disable that type.

push_enabled.description: Master switch for in-app/device push notifications.

email_enabled.description: Email notifications (friend requests, direct messages, deal updates).

background_location_alerts.description: Background geofence alerts when near favorite venues (requires location tracking).

location_tracking.description: Foreground location tracking used for nearby deal alerts.

auto_reload_updates.description: Automatically apply app updates when a new version is available.

tools.name: list_activity
tools.title: List my recent JetCard activity
tools.description: Return the signed-in user's recent JetCard activity — saved and removed favorites, shared deals, and venue reviews — each with a timestamp, venue, and action, newest first.

since_hours.description: Only include activity from the last N hours (default: no time limit).

tools.name: list_my_venues
tools.title: List my venues and deals
tools.description: Return every venue and deal associated with the signed-in user's account — saved favorites (venues and deals), reviewed venues, and shared deals — grouped by venue with the reason for each association.

active_deals_only.description: Only include deals that are currently active and not expired.

tools.name: push_preferences
tools.title: Push notification preferences
tools.description: View or update the signed-in user's push notification preferences for JetCard updates and merchant offers. Call with no arguments to read current settings; pass any flag to change it.

push_enabled.description: Master device push switch. Turning this off silences all push topics.

jetcard_updates.description: Push about JetCard membership/status changes and account updates.

merchant_offers.description: Push when merchants activate new deals or offers.

favorite_venue_alerts.description: Push when a saved/favorite venue posts or updates a deal.

ending_soon_reminders.description: Push when a saved deal is about to expire.

direct_messages.description: Push for direct messages from other users.

tools.name: get_tier_benefits
tools.title: Get my tier benefits and promotions
tools.description: Return the benefits included with the signed-in user's current JetCard tier, plus the promotions/deals currently available to that tier and what upgrading would unlock.

promotions_limit.description: Maximum number of currently available promotions to return.

tools.name: list_active_promotions
tools.title: List my active promotions
tools.description: List the promotions/deals that are currently active and available to the signed-in user, including each promotion's expiration date, time remaining, and the eligibility conditions (active days of week, start/end window, membership tier, venue, and whether the user has saved it).

only_favorites.description: When true, only return promotions for venues or deals the user has saved as favorites.

venue_id.description: Optional venue id to restrict promotions to a single venue.

expiring_within_hours.description: Optional filter: only promotions expiring within this many hours.

limit.description: Maximum number of promotions to return.

tools.name: whoami
tools.title: Who am I
tools.description: Return the signed-in JET-Around user's profile summary. Useful to verify the connection works.
